module: Part of the third-party LuaIRC library (IRC client in Lua). Adds to the connection metatable `irc._META` the sending commands: raw message, PRIVMSG, NOTICE, JOIN, PART, MODE and enabling user tracking. File loaded by libs/LuaIRC/init via require "irc.asyncoperations"; it uses the `module "irc"` form (Lua 5.1) and returns nothing.
notes: The methods are only accessible after a successful connect() (before that, the meta_preconnect metatable raises an error).
Command parameters are validated by verify(): a string starting with ':' (or containing a space followed by a NUL) causes a 'malformed parameter' error.
Probable bug: in meta:send, error(err, errlevel) uses a variable `errlevel` that is never defined (nil, so default level).

meta.desc: Metatable of connected IRC connections (the methods are called with ':' on the object returned by irc.new).

send.desc: Sends a raw line to the server (suffixed with \r\n). If extra arguments are given, msg is passed to string.format. Fires the OnSend hook before sending; on a socket error other than timeout/wantwrite, fires OnDisconnect, closes the connection and raises the error.

msg.desc: IRC line, or string.format format if arguments follow

sendChat.desc: Sends a PRIVMSG message to a channel or a user. A multi-line message is split into one command per line.

sendNotice.desc: Like sendChat but with the NOTICE command (one command per line of the message).

join.desc: Joins a channel, with an optional key (password).

part.desc: Leaves a channel. If user tracking is active, removes the channel from self.channels.

trackUsers.desc: Enables or disables per-channel user tracking (self.track_users). When disabling, empties self.channels.

b.desc: true to track, false to stop

setMode.desc: Sends a MODE command. The table can contain add (modes to add) and/or remove (modes to remove); at least one of the two is required (assert).

t.desc: {target = target (default: its own nickname), add = 'mode string', remove = 'mode string'}
